name: Entity Reference Formatter Access Bypass
description: An entity-reference formatter that renders referenced entities the viewer cannot access using an admin-chosen fallback view mode (deliberately bypassing access).
project_description:
The Entity reference formatter access bypass module extends the Entity view

reference formatter and allow to select a view mode as fallback in case a user

cannot access to an entity.

 By default, if a user cannot access to an entity, the entity will not be

displayed.

With this fallback setting, entity can be displayed in specific view mode to

display only data the user can access.

 Configuration 
 Choose 'Rendered entity with access bypass fallback' formatter in Entity

reference and configure both default view mode and fallback view mode.
